text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Come savor the exquisite gourmet delicacies nurtured by the northern lands—lured by that slogan, I visited the Hokkaido Specialty Fair.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Flown in straight from Tomakomai Port,
a migratory bird on wings of paper! Surf-clam lover☆
Tomakomai's local idol, Hokko Tarumae!
choice_data_list: (That girl is a Tracen Academy student, right……?)
(That girl's a Tracen Academy student, isn't she……?)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'll be doing a food review of the beloved treat
from Tomakomai, where I serve as tourism ambassador—
the one and only Yoitomake!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The jam made from these haskap berries pairs wonderfully with the sponge cake!
It makes for an exquisite roll cake!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Well then, without further ado... thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...♪ There it is!
That refreshing tartness and fluffy sweetness...♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
When I helped out in the shopping district, the candy shop grandma
used to feed me treats all the time.
...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Yoitomake, the taste of home~
Ah, Yoitomake, brings peace to my soul... ♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...That was "Come On Over to Tomakomai," written and composed by Hokko Tarumae.
Arranged in the Yoitomake style.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: My heart felt so full of emotion... that I just started singing without realizing it... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her smile was overflowing with tender love for her hometown...
Before I knew it, I called out to her.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
!
...Ah, that badge—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: You're a Tracen Academy Trainer, right? I'm so happy... that you're taking an interest in me!
choice_data_list: Local idols sure do a wide variety of activities.
Local idols sure do a wide variety of activities.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Writing songs about Tomakomai for our lives,
doing promotional work for my hometown—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: As a local idol, I'm ready to take on any job that comes my way!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
So that lots of people can learn
all about my hometown――Tomakomai!
choice_data_list: Your food reviewing skills were incredible, too.
I'd love to hear more Tomakomai recommendations~

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Fufu, . To tell you the truth, I've also been studying food reviews by popular idols.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
To get people interested in Tomakomai cuisine,
mastering the art of conveying deliciousness is an absolute must!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! If you'd like, why don't you
stick around to watch my food reviews for the other local specialties?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Every bit of food grown in Tomakomai
is the taste of my beloved hometown♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Oh, gladly! There are so many wonderful things about Tomakomai, after all!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
When people think of Tomakomai, majestic nature is what comes to mind!
There's Lake Utonai where migratory birds rest, and Mount Tarumae with its rich flora! And also—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, with sparkling eyes, she went on to
recommend plenty of Tomakomai's charms to me.
